texts.arguments: 2. The learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner contends that the petitioner is a non- governmental organization, registered under the West Bengal Societies Registration Act, 1961, engaged inter alia in ensuring the safety of consumers in general. Learned Senior Counsel places reliance on Regulation 10(2) of the Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018, which stipulates that there shall not appear in the label of any package, containing food for sale, the words "recommended by the medical or nutrition or health professionals" or any words which imply or suggest that the food is recommended, prescribed or approved by medical practitioners or approved for medical purpose. It is alleged that such norms is palpably flouted by one Budge Budge Refineries Limited, under the brand name "Doctor's Independent Research Ethics Society vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 23 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135566969/ 1 Choice". 5. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent nos. 4 to 6 contends that already steps have been initiated by the said authorities, by issuance of Improvement Notices under Section 32 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 against the alleged perpetrators. 6. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent nos. 1 to 3 hands over the copy of a written instruction, which is kept on record, indicating that a complaint was forwarded by the Additional Secretary, Government of West Bengal, Department of Health and Family Welfare (Food Safety) to the Regional Director, Eastern Region, FSSSAI on April 20, 2023, but no action taken report has been available as yet.
